disposition: Retain one inactive attributed utility hypothesis; reject generic communication/attention novelty.
one_question: Does a single receiver-specific exchange among live route states before the next native graph block improve competent acquisition and served retention beyond added per-route capacity and the same joint forward trained only for its served prediction?
not_repeating: Saved scalar source-attention pooling broadcasts one message to all routes.
Saved global low-rank member projector performs node-independent signed linear mixing only at the neighbor-message site.
Saved frozen hidden residual readout fits after frozen routes.
FFL/PCL and HGEN/LHGEL/SAGMM establish joint hidden fusion and related supervision; their cited final fusion placements are not proof of useful continuing-route interaction.
exact_collision: The receiver-specific nonlinear primitive is standard set self-attention. The continuing-stream communication principle is already Cross-stitch/sluice. Flattening the four route states gives one structured width4D model with tied projections and grouped route updates. There is no expressivity separation from a same-evidence capable attention model, and no new ensemble principle is asserted.
usefulness_not_rejected_by_ancestry: Known ancestry permits a useful matched comparator. The unmeasured empirical question concerns placement, objective and quality/cost, rather than invention of interaction.
closest_published_alternative: Cross-stitch1604.03539v1 Section3.3: learned per-channel stream mixing between continuing layers. A four-route same-label graph port at the identical site is the closest continuing-stream comparator. SetTransformer1810.00825v3 Section3.1 is the exact nonlinear interaction primitive.
falsifiable_distinction_from_ordinary_at: Routes continue through native graph/root/nonlinear updates and retain separately supervised own predictions. This is an architecture/objective contract, not statistical independence.

The identical coupled forward trained on CE of the fixed served pool is a capable structured single-predictor control. If it matches the candidate, the result supports an interaction representation/optimization effect and does not require ensemble own supervision.
If a parameter-matched route-separable residual block matches, interaction is unnecessary.
If node-independent Cross-stitch and label-free recipient/weight interventions explain the gain, receiver-specific attention has not earned its cost.
If hidden spread increases while mean/worst own quality or final served quality falls, reject the useful ensemble explanation.
no_missing_world_information_claim: The interaction introduces no new observed topology, features or labels. It recombines and jointly trains route states; it cannot recover information absent from the complete hidden bank merely by being called an ensemble.
acquisition_and_retention: Use exact frozen baseline shared-rival Q and stronger factorizedI4 coverage A_F. Report candidate correct-member supply and actual served repairs on Q outside A_F separately, retained/lost I4/baseline relative repairs, shared successes, outside harms and truth-class counts. A served repair can occur without an individually correct member and must be counted separately. No VALID-derived coefficient/arm choice.
